<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout
    xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
    xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto"
    android:layout_width="match_parent"
    android:layout_height="match_parent"
    android:fitsSystemWindows="true"
    android:background="@color/background_primary">

    <!-- Environment bar -->
    <LinearLayout
        android:id="@+id/llEnvironment"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:orientation="horizontal"
        android:paddingTop="8dp"
        android:paddingBottom="8dp"
        android:paddingStart="16dp"
        android:paddingEnd="16dp"
        android:background="@color/card_background"
        android:gravity="center_vertical"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">

        <!-- Left side: Temperature and Altitude -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="0dp"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:layout_weight="1"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:gravity="center_vertical">

            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="24dp"
                android:layout_height="24dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_thermometer"
                android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"/>

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tvTemperature"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="@string/drag_temperature_placeholder"
                android:textSize="16sp"
                android:textColor="@color/text_primary"
                android:layout_marginEnd="16dp" />

            <ImageView
                android:layout_width="24dp"
                android:layout_height="24dp"
                android:src="@drawable/ic_altitude"
                android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"/>

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tvAltitude"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="@string/drag_altitude_placeholder"
                android:textSize="16sp"
                android:textColor="@color/text_primary" />
        </LinearLayout>

        <!-- Right side: Profile model name and image -->
        <LinearLayout
            android:id="@+id/llActiveProfileHeader"
            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="horizontal"
            android:gravity="center_vertical"
            android:padding="5dp"
            android:layout_marginStart="12dp">

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tvHeaderModelName"
                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                android:textSize="16sp"
                android:textStyle="bold"
                android:layout_marginEnd="8dp"
                android:text=""
                android:minWidth="30dp"
                android:visibility="visible" />

            <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView
                android:id="@+id/cardProfileImage"
                android:layout_width="38dp"
                android:layout_height="38dp"
                app:cardCornerRadius="19dp"
                app:cardElevation="0dp"
                app:strokeWidth="1.5dp"
                app:strokeColor="#4DFFFFFF"
                android:visibility="visible">

                <ImageView
                    android:id="@+id/ivHeaderProfileImage"
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="match_parent"
                    android:scaleType="centerCrop"
                    android:src="@drawable/ic_car"
                    android:visibility="visible"
                    android:contentDescription="Profile image" />
            </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
        </LinearLayout>

    </LinearLayout>

    <!-- Bottom navigation is handled by MainContainerActivity - removed from here -->

    <!-- Start button - По-малък, долу в центъра -->
    <Button
        android:id="@+id/btnStartNewSession"
        android:layout_width="wrap_content"
        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
        android:minWidth="200dp"
        android:text= "@string/start_track_session"
        android:textSize="14sp"
        android:paddingStart="24dp"
        android:paddingEnd="24dp"
        android:layout_marginBottom="6dp"
        android:backgroundTint="@color/primary_color"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent"/>

    <!-- Sessions list -->
    <androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView
        android:id="@+id/scrollSessions"
        android:layout_width="0dp"
        android:layout_height="0dp"
        android:fillViewport="true"
        android:clipToPadding="false"
        android:paddingStart="8dp"
        android:paddingEnd="8dp"
        app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/llEnvironment"
        app:layout_constraintBottom_toTopOf="@id/btnStartNewSession"
        app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent"
        app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">

        <LinearLayout
            android:layout_width="match_parent"
            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
            android:orientation="vertical"
            android:paddingBottom="24dp">

            <TextView
                android:id="@+id/tvNoSessions"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:text="@string/track_no_sessions"
                android:textSize="18sp"
                android:textColor="@color/text_secondary"
                android:gravity="center"
                android:paddingTop="48dp"
                android:paddingBottom="48dp"
                android:visibility="visible" />

            <LinearLayout
                android:id="@+id/llSessionsContainer"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:orientation="vertical"
                android:layout_marginTop="15dp"
                />

            <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                android:id="@+id/cardSofiaRing"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
                android:visibility="gone"
                app:cardBackgroundColor="#2A2D30"
                app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
                app:cardElevation="4dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="vertical">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:id="@+id/headerSofiaRing"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:orientation="horizontal"
                        android:gravity="center_vertical"
                        android:padding="20dp"
                        android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:orientation="vertical">

                            <TextView
                                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:text=""
                                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                                android:textSize="18sp"
                                android:textStyle="bold" />

                            <TextView
                                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:text="3.2km • 12 завоя • Гърция"
                                android:textColor="#9E9E9E"
                                android:textSize="14sp"
                                android:layout_marginTop="4dp" />

                        </LinearLayout>

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/arrowSofiaRing"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="▼"
                            android:textColor="#4CAF50"
                            android:textSize="16sp"
                            android:textStyle="bold" />
                    </LinearLayout>

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:id="@+id/contentSofiaRing"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:orientation="vertical"
                        android:visibility="gone">

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvNoSessionsSofia"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/track_no_sessions_today"
                            android:textColor="#9E9E9E"
                            android:textSize="14sp"
                            android:gravity="center"
                            android:padding="32dp"
                            android:visibility="gone" />

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:id="@+id/session1SofiaRing"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:orientation="vertical"
                            android:padding="16dp"
                            android:layout_margin="8dp"
                            android:layout_marginTop="0dp"
                            android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground"
                            android:visibility="gone">

                            <LinearLayout
                                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:orientation="horizontal"
                                android:gravity="center_vertical"
                                android:layout_marginBottom="12dp">

                                <TextView
                                    android:layout_width="0dp"
                                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                    android:layout_weight="1"
                                    android:text="@string/track_session_title"
                                    android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                                    android:textSize="16sp"
                                    android:textStyle="bold" />

                                <TextView
                                    android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                    android:text="14:30"
                                    android:textColor="#4CAF50"
                                    android:textSize="18sp"
                                    android:textStyle="bold" />
                            </LinearLayout>
                        </LinearLayout>

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:id="@+id/session2SofiaRing"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:orientation="vertical"
                            android:padding="16dp"
                            android:layout_margin="8dp"
                            android:layout_marginTop="0dp"
                            android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground"
                            android:visibility="gone" />

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:id="@+id/session3SofiaRing"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:orientation="vertical"
                            android:padding="16dp"
                            android:layout_margin="8dp"
                            android:layout_marginTop="0dp"
                            android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground"
                            android:visibility="gone" />
                    </LinearLayout>
                </LinearLayout>
            </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

            <androidx.cardview.widget.CardView
                android:id="@+id/cardCustomTrack"
                android:layout_width="match_parent"
                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                android:layout_marginBottom="16dp"
                android:visibility="gone"
                app:cardBackgroundColor="#2A2D30"
                app:cardCornerRadius="12dp"
                app:cardElevation="4dp">

                <LinearLayout
                    android:layout_width="match_parent"
                    android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                    android:orientation="vertical">

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:id="@+id/headerCustomTrack"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:orientation="horizontal"
                        android:gravity="center_vertical"
                        android:padding="20dp"
                        android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground">

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:layout_width="0dp"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_weight="1"
                            android:orientation="vertical">

                            <TextView
                                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:text="Custom Track"
                                android:textColor="#FFFFFF"
                                android:textSize="18sp"
                                android:textStyle="bold" />

                            <TextView
                                android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                                android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                                android:text="22.12.2024 • 2 излизания"
                                android:textColor="#9E9E9E"
                                android:textSize="14sp"
                                android:layout_marginTop="4dp" />
                        </LinearLayout>

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/arrowCustomTrack"
                            android:layout_width="wrap_content"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="▼"
                            android:textColor="#FF9800"
                            android:textSize="16sp"
                            android:textStyle="bold" />
                    </LinearLayout>

                    <LinearLayout
                        android:id="@+id/contentCustomTrack"
                        android:layout_width="match_parent"
                        android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                        android:orientation="vertical"
                        android:visibility="gone">

                        <TextView
                            android:id="@+id/tvNoSessionsCustom"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:text="@string/track_no_sessions_today"
                            android:textColor="#9E9E9E"
                            android:textSize="14sp"
                            android:gravity="center"
                            android:padding="32dp"
                            android:visibility="gone" />

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:id="@+id/session1CustomTrack"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:orientation="vertical"
                            android:padding="16dp"
                            android:layout_margin="8dp"
                            android:layout_marginTop="0dp"
                            android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground"
                            android:visibility="gone" />

                        <LinearLayout
                            android:id="@+id/session2CustomTrack"
                            android:layout_width="match_parent"
                            android:layout_height="wrap_content"
                            android:orientation="vertical"
                            android:padding="16dp"
                            android:layout_margin="8dp"
                            android:layout_marginTop="0dp"
                            android:background="?android:attr/selectableItemBackground"
                            android:visibility="gone" />
                    </LinearLayout>
                </LinearLayout>
            </androidx.cardview.widget.CardView>

        </LinearLayout>
    </androidx.core.widget.NestedScrollView>

</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
